This project is Alder Lab Gateway, a made-up lab system used for a demo. All data is synthetic.
Use plain JavaScript (ES modules), small pure functions, no new dependencies.
Write test cases in the agreed table format: id, type (nominal or edge), steps, expected result. Keep the case id in the test name.
Never invent clinical limits. Limits come from the story or from the lab.
Never edit src/Access/. Ask for a person to review it.
